integrity: Finite computations are corroboration, not an unrestricted proof; no external independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Capacity-one only; no closed polynomial for all feasible sets, no arbitrary Cartesian factors; possible equivalent older result under nearly-perfect or subcube-code terminology. Previously known two-factor rook and binary-cube special cases are not claimed new.
title: Face-code classification of one-limited domination in generalized Hamming graphs
